argv: Carry out the task described in the attached file. End with your final answer.

notes: Model is provider/model, e.g. anthropic/<model> or deepseek/<model>; OpenCode itself reaches DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen and local models. --auto approves permissions that are not explicitly denied.
